roundNote: Round 15 is one forward merge of main f699b131 (#2607, which stops releasing the OpenCode plugin), at code fea4f37c. The architect scoped it to the merge's five points (Envoy f0aa3e8e). Retro's commit 1e8492bf removed .legion/INFRA-588/, so this handoff is written fresh, and previousHandoff names that removal.

implementerProof.how: I re-ran each of the implementer's commands on the merged tree in the workspace: layout checker, release-push.test.sh, check-release-credentials.sh and its test, check-ci-filters.sh, fold-orphans and the fold's plan step. I also re-ran their negative control: an envoy-plugin fragment on top of the merge makes fold-orphans exit 1. Then I did the comparison they summarised as a fingerprint myself, file by file, against the approved diff. All hold.

proof.criterion: (1) Outside the conflict, the diff against main equals the approved diff at d696ff64
proof.surface: git diff in a scratch clone: approved = 1a9095e6 (d696ff64's merge base with main) -> d696ff64; merged = main f699b131 -> fea4f37c; .legion/ and docs/solutions/ (retro's) left out
proof.command: the changed-file lists of both diffs; then, for each file, the sha1 of its -U0 added and removed lines in each diff
proof.observed: 54 files in each, the same 54. 51 have identical change lines. The 3 that differ are the conflict #2607 caused: .github/changelog-packages lacks the line packages/envoy-plugin=opencode-legion-envoy-v; changelog-fold.yaml's removed CHANGELOG_PACKAGES line is main's version without envoy-plugin; AGENTS.md's line says 'the six packages … (pi-legion, pi-envoy, envoy, claude-envoy, contracts, envoy-client)' where the approved line said seven with envoy-plugin
proof.negativeControl: the per-file comparison does flag differences: those three files

proof.criterion: (2) .github/changelog-packages holds exactly main's six specs, and changelog-fold.yaml reads that file with no CHANGELOG_PACKAGES
proof.surface: the merged tree fea4f37c and main f699b131
proof.command: diff of main's CHANGELOG_PACKAGES value, split one word per line, against .github/changelog-packages; grep -c CHANGELOG_PACKAGES and grep -c 'packages=$(<.github/changelog-packages)' in the merged changelog-fold.yaml
proof.observed: identical, 6 lines, same order (no envoy-plugin); CHANGELOG_PACKAGES 0 times in changelog-fold.yaml; the file is read in 3 steps. The fold's plan step on the merged tree: exit 0, no warning, packages claude-envoy, envoy, envoy-client, pi-envoy and pi-legion planned (contracts has no fragment)
proof.negativeControl: a commit adding packages/envoy-plugin/.changes/unreleased/x.yaml on the merge: fold-orphans exit 1 naming it, and the fold's plan exits 0 with one ::warning::

proof.criterion: (3) AGENTS.md names the file and six packages, and the layout checker exits 0

proof.observed: AGENTS.md:539 'the six packages `.github/changelog-packages` lists (`pi-legion`, `pi-envoy`, `envoy`, `claude-envoy`, `contracts`, `envoy-client`), the one list the fold and the check below both read'; layout exit 0; CHANGELOG_PACKAGES remains only in check-release-credentials.test.sh's synthetic fixture, as in round 13
